# Context

Status: current

## Idea

- Vision: Agency owners see every lead and deal in one calm place.
- User: Owner of a 5 to 20 person agency who sells retainers.
- MVP: Leads list, pipeline board, tasks, revenue view.
- Out of scope: Email sending, invoicing, mobile app.
- Next step: Interview 5 agency owners about how they track leads today.

## Who it is for

- Agency owners.
